Alexa Wernick Psychotherapy, LCSW, PLLC is therapy practice providing mental health services to children & adolescents using evidence based practices such as CBT, SPACE, PMT and play therapy elements. Alexa Wernick, LCSW has a certificate in Child and Family Therapy, extensive understanding of child development, and utilizes modalities including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), play therapy, family systems theory, SPACE (Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotions) , Parent Management Training (PMT) and talk therapy in her practice.  
 
Alexa Wernick Psychotherapy works mainly with those experiencing anxiety (general, social, separation), ADHD, low frustration tolerance, and difficulty regulating emotions. chools, and others engaged in a child’s life. She is passionate about incorporating creative arts & play into sessions, using drawing, imaginary play, & floor time to help children become aware of their body/mind connection. Her creative approach helps clients engage meaningfully in therapy while they learn evidence-based skills to help them succeed outside of sessions. Alexa strongly values a team approach, collaborating with families, schools, and others engaged in a child’s life.

Parent coaching/training is also provided to parents/caregivers to teach tools and strategies to best support their children in emotional regulation and other areas of life. 

Alexa provides educational workshops to parents that focus on behavior management strategies for at home, as well as going into schools for professional staff development centered on behavior management, implementation of social emotional learning, response to behavior and more. 

Alexa Wernick Psychotherapy sees clients both in person and virtually. Alexa Wernick, LCSW (business owner) is licensed in both NY and FL.

Sweet Catch is more than just a restaurant; it’s a heartfelt mission led by a Black woman entrepreneur whose aim is to bring together her culture, flavor, and community. This seafood and soul food dining experience is deeply rooted in paying home age and the goal to have more representation, and ownership in the restaurant sector. With a focus on honoring tradition while pushing forward innovation, Sweet Catch delivers comfort food that warms the soul and reflects the vibrant culinary traditions of Black culture. At Sweet Catch, every detail is driven by a commitment to hospitality and community. The owner, a proud advocate for representation and empowerment, envisions a future where more Black-owned restaurants flourish across the country. The goal isn’t just to serve food but to nurture a culture of ownership and pride within marginalized communities. Sweet Catch aspires to be a beacon of opportunity, providing jobs, mentorship, and inspiration for others aspiring to enter the culinary and hospitality industries. The restaurant’s mission is simple yet powerful: ensure that everyone who walks through the doors feels valued and leaves with a satisfied heart and stomach. At Sweet Catch, the atmosphere is warm, inviting, and unapologetically authentic. Guests are treated like family, welcomed with the kind of genuine hospitality that’s rooted in Southern tradition but accessible to everyone. Whether it’s a first-time visitor or a loyal regular, each person is met with warmth and served dishes that are crafted with love. The menu is a vibrant blend of seafood staples and soul food classics, seasoned with the kind of spices and expertise that tell a story of heritage and passion. From shrimp and grits to collard greens, catfish to cornbread, each dish is a celebration of tradition reimagined with a modern twist. The fusion of flavors and textures reflects the diversity within Black culinary history, allowing guests to taste the richness of a culture that’s often underrepresented in mainstream food spaces. Sweet Catch isn’t just a restaurant; it’s a community hub. It’s a place where locals gather not just for the food but for the experience of togetherness. From hosting community events to offering pop-ups that highlight emerging Black chefs and food vendors, Sweet Catch aims to be a cornerstone of its neighborhood. The restaurant is designed to give back, reinvesting into the very communities it serves, with a focus on initiatives that promote economic empowerment, education, and arts. Looking forward, Sweet Catch has ambitions to expand into various markets across the country, spreading its mission of community-focused dining and Black ownership. The goal is to create a chain of Sweet Catch locations that each retain their local charm while sharing a unified vision. Each new opening is more than a business expansion; it’s an opportunity to plant the seeds of inclusion, representation, and community-building in new soil. As Sweet Catch grows, it remains committed to its core values: hospitality, community, and quality. With every plate served, the restaurant moves closer to fulfilling its mission—creating a space where everyone is seen, valued, and well-fed.

Styled By B is my personal and fashion styling company that empowers individuals to express their authentic selves through style. I provide services for Executives, Entrepreneurs, and Professionals who are looking to elevate their personal and professional image. My mission is to help clients discover and embrace their unique style, boosting their confidence and enabling them to show up fully in all areas of their lives.

As the Founder of Styled By B and a #1 Bestselling Author, I've been in the world of Personal Styling and Entrepreneurship for over six years. My business goes beyond fashion – it's about helping people feel more confident, aligned with who they are, and empowered to succeed. From Wardrobe Styling to Closet Audits and personalized shopping experiences, my services are tailored to meet the specific needs and budgets of my clients.

I offer three levels of service: Style Consultations, Wardrobe Styling Packages, and the Luxe Style Experience. I also provide exclusive services like the VIP Experience at a top luxury retailer and ‘The Elite Style Concierge,’ which offers ongoing support through a monthly retainer package. My approach is personal and designed to help Professionals excel in their careers while embracing their creativity and authenticity.

What sets Styled By B apart is my focus on Professionals who might not see themselves as creative, particularly those in Business, Math, Science, and Tech. I help them use style as a tool to build confidence and project leadership. My clients are often well-established in their careers, seeking more than just success – they want to feel fulfilled and express their true selves.

In addition to one-on-one services, I teach style workshops to Corporate Employees, Entrepreneurs, High Schools, and Colleges, empowering individuals to develop their personal style in a way that aligns with their career goals and personal aspirations.

Community involvement is a big part of my work. I mentor students interested in Fashion careers and host events that highlight diversity and inclusion in fashion. I’m also passionate about supporting causes that empower people to rebuild confidence and adapt to new circumstances through the power of personal style.

Styled By B is about more than just looking good – it’s about feeling capable, confident, and ready to take on whatever comes next. Through my personalized services and commitment to empowerment, I help people step into their best selves, both personally and professionally.

rows.business_description:
La Estrella Del Castillo Restaurant is a vibrant Latin American eatery located in the heart of Crown Heights, Brooklyn—just east of Prospect Park. Rooted in tradition and flavor, this neighborhood gem offers a diverse menu that celebrates the rich culinary heritage of Latin America. From beloved staples like Mofongo and Palomilla Steak to elevated dishes such as Lobster Tail Stuffed with Shrimp, every meal is crafted with care and authenticity.
Beyond lunch and dinner, La Estrella Del Castillo also serves hearty breakfasts, comforting soups, indulgent desserts, and classic favorites like hamburgers, sandwiches, and chicken dishes. Whether you're in the mood for a fresh cup of coffee or a full Latin-inspired feast, the menu delivers a little something for everyone.
Guests can enjoy the convenience of online ordering for both carryout and delivery, making it easy to savor bold flavors from the comfort of home. With a welcoming atmosphere and a menu as diverse as the community it serves, La Estrella Del Castillo is a proud culinary beacon in Brooklyn.

rows.business_description: Cinemakidz is a youth media arts educational program. Cinemakidz offers children ages 5 -15 the opportunity to explore the world of moviemaking in an engaging and interdisciplinary manner. The company offers after school classes, birthday parties, summer and vacation workshops, weekend workshops and free events throughout the city. Filmmaking is such an amazing all-encompassing process and children who take the classes often realize passions they never knew existed. The business works closely with every student to help them discover what they love about filmmaking. Cinemakidz's classes are interdisciplinary in their design and includes building, robotics, historical research, critical thinking skills, writing, art, engineering, and more.
